title: The Knowledge Store
brief: Teach the agent your business language. On the Wealth & Distribution agent:
- Add synonyms for 10 business terms. Start with AUM, AUA, net new money, equities, cash.
- Author 8 SQL expressions: 3 filters, 4 measures, 1 field.
- Declare the join relationships rather than leaving Genie to guess them.
Then re-run the questions that failed in Lab 4 and show which now pass.
Remember the ceiling: 200 knowledge store snippets per agent, shared between table
descriptions, join relationships and SQL expressions.

checks.name: 8 or more SQL expressions
checks.hint: Filters, measures and fields all count. A measure defined once cannot drift.

checks.name: At least 3 filters
checks.hint: Settled only, exclude exchanges, discretionary only.

checks.name: At least 4 measures
checks.hint: AUM, AUA, held-away and net flows are the four that get argued about.

checks.name: 10 or more synonyms across the SQL snippets
checks.hint: Users say 'net new money', not 'sum of signed flow amounts'.
